Container.Name: android-backup
Container.Overview: Backs up Android phones and tablets to your array over ADB, with no root and no app on the device. Plug a device in, or give it a Wi-Fi address, and it gets one backup per day: shared storage (photos, downloads, documents), every user-installed APK, contacts as vCard, SMS and call log in SMS Backup & Restore format, and settings. Files deleted on the phone are kept in the backup. Private app data (logins, app databases) can't be backed up without root. Status page + Prometheus /metrics on port 9872, optional Discord alerts.
Container.Requires: USB debugging turned on on each device, and "Allow" tapped once when it's first connected.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Each device gets a <model>-<serial> folder. It holds messages and contacts in plain text, so use a private share.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: State, logs and the adb key devices trust; keep this folder private

Config.Name: USB devices
Config.Description: For devices plugged into the server

Config.Name: Backup interval (hours)
Config.Description: Minimum time between good backups of a device

Config.Name: Wi-Fi devices
Config.Description: Optional comma list of host:port, e.g. 192.168.1.50:5555. See the README for setup.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for logs and snapshot dates

Config.Name: Only these serials
Config.Description: Optional comma list; default = every authorised device
